extracted.name: Sun-Dried Tomato Dip
extracted.description: This creamy dip featuring with sun-dried tomatoes, basil, and garlic tastes great on EVERYTHING!
ingredient_lines: 0.25 cup oil-packed sun-dried tomatoes, drained and chopped
instruction_lines: Combine sun-dried tomatoes, cream cheese, sour cream, mayonnaise, garlic, hot pepper sauce, salt, and pepper in a food processor; process until well blended. Add basil and process until smooth.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 1 hour before serving.
